title: Mandatory Learning Completion
scope: Applies to Business Analysts during their first 30 days.
summary: Defines completion and evidence requirements for mandatory learning.
details: Complete modules by the due date.
Employees must complete their own assessments.
Report access problems before the deadline.
employee_actions: Raise a Training ticket for access issues.
escalation: Escalate unresolved access issues to Learning Support.
exceptions: Any exception requires documented approval from the policy owner.
